:::{#def-exponential}
#### Exponential distribution

A random variable $T$ has the **exponential distribution** with rate $\rate > 0$
[@wikipedia_exponential_distribution]
if $T$ is continuous with [density](#def-pdf):

$$
f(t) \eqdef \begin{cases}
\rate \ef{-\rate t}, & t \ge 0 \\
0, & t < 0
\end{cases}
$$

:::
